text:
Iris N.: heads-up: ran into a subtle streaming parity + auth/retry interaction on the sampleapp that produces out-of-order tiny-deltas after a fast reconnect.
Ben T.: ugh. quick summary?
Iris N.: repro: sampleapp (android polyfill) hits /v1/stream, server emits a small multi-line event split across TCP frames. simulate 130ms drop -> reconnect with resume header. sometimes we get duplicate delta A then delta B missing.
Jordan: logs?
Iris N.: raw capture: 
```
event: message
data: {"id":"evt-42","part":1,"text":"hel"

# reconnect
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: staging.api
> last-event-id: evt-42

# server replays buffered 'part1' as a complete event then later the rest is skipped
```
Ben T.: two things: 1) header casing & sdk parity. node sdk sets both Last-Event-ID + last-event-id, python/mobile often only lowercases. proxies can lowercase so server resume check may miss it. 2) parser flush-on-eof: if parser treats mid-event EOF as finished, the partial gets re-emitted after resume.
Iris N.: also noticed auth retry: some clients reauth during reconnect and send a fresh token which our router treats as a new session -> we don't dedupe resume tokens when auth header changes. leads to duplicate processing.
Jordan: action items: 
- quick: add router middleware to canonicalize resume header to "Last-Event-Id" regardless of case.
- quick: dedupe by event id in resume logic (idempotent apply).
- medium: update sdks/sampleapps to include canonical header and a tiny jittered reconnect backoff in mobile demos to avoid hitting the race during onboarding.
- add e2e that splits a final event across two writes and forces a reconnect + optional auth refresh to catch both duplication and missing-event cases.
Iris N.: opened sampleapp PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/128 (adds canonical header and jittered reconnect).
ci-bot: build #7120 started for sampleapp/pr-128.
Ben T.: i'll open a small PR for router middleware + unit test for mid-chunk EOF handling.
Jordan: let's also add a one-paragraph note in the SDK onboarding guide about EventSource polyfills and resume header behavior to reduce customer confusion. :memo:
